title: Neural Reaction-Diffusion Operators for Spatially Heterogeneous Tumor Modeling

contributions.purpose: 扩展神经算子理论到空间异质系数
contributions.mechanism: 异质性感知特征提取+自适应谱卷积+物理约束(守恒/非负)
contributions.evaluation: 声称近似误差界含C3||D-Dapprox||项(理论,无完整证明)
contributions.source_quote: We extend neural operator theory to handle spatially varying coefficients through heterogeneity-aware feature extraction and adaptive spectral processing

contributions.mechanism: 异质性编码器+基于注意力的自适应Fourier模+多尺度积分
contributions.source_quote: NRDOs employ adaptive Fourier modes selected based on local heterogeneity patterns, physics-informed attention mechanisms

contributions.purpose: 给出近似/收敛理论保证

contributions.evaluation: checklist自认无完整证明(Q3=No),仅proof sketch
